name: PhotoBand
description: A full-width photo band, 800px tall (240 on screens narrower than 1024px). As the LAST slice on a page it pins while the footer slides up over it. Left empty it is the garnet gradient

variations.name: Default
variations.description: One photo, cropped from the top and anchored to the band's bottom edge

config.label: Photo — 3:2 or wider, at least 2880px wide; its bottom edge is kept, the top is cropped. Describe it in the image's alt text, or leave that empty if it is decoration
